evidence.reason: The dependency-reuse guard compares package.json, lockfiles, workspace config, and several package-manager config files, but not `.pnpmfile.cjs`. pnpm loads that hook to modify package manifests/resolution, so a changed hook can produce different installed dependencies even when the existing compared files, including the lockfile, are unchanged. Reusing a prepared root then passes the guard while retaining stale resolution behavior. Adding `.pnpmfile.cjs` to the byte-compared paths is the smallest correctness fix; no owner decision is needed.
